facts.fact: The article says a Cloud First doctrine of 2024 reinforced the 2023 orientation of public systems and services towards labelled cloud providers, and that a circular of 2 September 2026 tightens hosting requirements for public bodies.
The article says the national cybersecurity agency (ANCS) published a list of labelled providers on 17 September 2026 with six N-Cloud entries, the providers public bodies are directed to.

systems.tiers: public bodies and their private suppliers
